title: L1CachePlugin IP Configuration Schema
description: Phase 1.3 L1CachePlugin configuration schema. Validates params used by L1CacheTLMBridge + L1CachePlugin. See .omo/drafts/decision-phase-1.3-bridge-2026-06-10.md §3 (D1=C: 4-field narrow bridge over POD Bundle).

impl_mode.description: 实现模式 (Phase 1 仅 TLM_ONLY 生效)

num_sets.description: 缓存 set 数 (典型 32KB 8-way L1 = 256 sets)

tag_bits.description: tag 位宽 (假设 40-bit 物理地址, 8-bit idx, 12-bit offset)

line_data_bits.description: cache line 数据位宽 (典型 64B = 512 bits; Phase 0 限制 >64 退化为 uint64_t)

replacement_policy.description: 替换策略 (Phase 1 实际只用 direct-mapped, 此字段为 forward-compat)

write_policy.description: 写策略 (Phase 1 仅 WriteBack 实现)
